chunks: And with this chain of this chain from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: "When you burp, do not raise your burping sound towards the sky."
ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic etiquette for burping according to the Prophet?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* within the chapter on food and drink, this hadith extends the Prophetic etiquette of modesty (*adab*) to natural bodily functions, linking physical humility with spiritual decorum. It reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on refining daily habits (*akhlaq*) as a means of cultivating reverence, ensuring that even mundane acts are performed with awareness of God’s presence.
